proposal_id.description: proposal_id defines the unique id of the proposal.

pagination.description: pagination defines an optional pagination for the request.

cosmos.gov.v1.QueryDepositsRequest.title: Query Deposits Request
cosmos.gov.v1.QueryDepositsRequest.description: QueryDepositsRequest is the request type for the Query/Deposits RPC method.

key.description: key is a value returned in PageResponse.next_key to begin querying the next page most efficiently. Only one of offset or key should be set.

offset.description: offset is a numeric offset that can be used when key is unavailable. It is less efficient than using key. Only one of offset or key should be set.

limit.description: limit is the total number of results to be returned in the result page. If left empty it will default to a value to be set by each app.

count_total.description: count_total is set to true  to indicate that the result set should include a count of the total number of items available for pagination in UIs. count_total is only respected when offset is used. It is ignored when key is set.

reverse.description: reverse is set to true if results are to be returned in the descending order.

cosmos.base.query.v1beta1.PageRequest.title: Page Request
cosmos.base.query.v1beta1.PageRequest.description: PageRequest is to be embedded in gRPC request messages for efficient pagination. Ex:  message SomeRequest {          Foo some_parameter = 1;          PageRequest pagination = 2;  }

pagination.description: pagination defines the pagination in the response.

cosmos.gov.v1.QueryDepositsResponse.title: Query Deposits Response
cosmos.gov.v1.QueryDepositsResponse.description: QueryDepositsResponse is the response type for the Query/Deposits RPC method.

next_key.description: next_key is the key to be passed to PageRequest.key to query the next page most efficiently. It will be empty if there are no more results.

total.description: total is total number of results available if PageRequest.count_total was set, its value is undefined otherwise

cosmos.base.query.v1beta1.PageResponse.title: Page Response
cosmos.base.query.v1beta1.PageResponse.description: PageResponse is to be embedded in gRPC response messages where the corresponding request message has used PageRequest.  message SomeResponse {          repeated Bar results = 1;          PageResponse page = 2;  }

cosmos.base.v1beta1.Coin.title: Coin
cosmos.base.v1beta1.Coin.description: Coin defines a token with a denomination and an amount. NOTE: The amount field is an Int which implements the custom method signatures required by gogoproto.

proposal_id.description: proposal_id defines the unique id of the proposal.

depositor.description: depositor defines the deposit addresses from the proposals.

amount.description: amount to be deposited by depositor.

cosmos.gov.v1.Deposit.title: Deposit
cosmos.gov.v1.Deposit.description: Deposit defines an amount deposited by an account address to an active proposal.
